mentions.name: Kurt Cobain chart gist
mentions.description: A gist containing an anonymized astrological chart (Kurt Cobain's) and its primary directions that can be fed into an LLM to converse with the chart; the LLM infers predicted events such as ages of success or public visibility and can then match them to the real person's life events, without the gist revealing whose chart it is.
mentions.source_excerpt: If you're into these kind of things, I created a gist [2] that you can feed into an LLM and talk to Kurt Cobain's chart. Note that it doesn't mention anywhere that it's Kurt Cobain.
